implementation_consequences: Registering an AE mask only in Pi0Inference._ACTION_LAYER_PATTERNS would leave the current eager adapter full18.
Routing the current D2 requests through the native decoder denoise_steps argument is unsupported by its3/5/7/10 whitelist.
A future AE mask must be inserted in a separately versioned adapter loop while preserving the current fusedD10 and customD2 arithmetic, noise, prefixKV copy and decoding.
New receipts should export actual layer visits and NFE. The current upper backend returns requested nodes but discards the adapter actual_NFE field.
